context_note_en: Ms Sophie asks Ms Lan to change their usual meeting time.

turns.english: Lan, can we meet at seven instead of six?

turns.speaker: Ms Sophie
turns.vietnamese: Tốt, hẹn gặp lúc bảy giờ nhé.
